words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He believes he will go to heaven after death.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己死后会去天堂。
words.en: In some religions, heaven is the place where God or the gods live and where good people go after they die.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr:
n. 硬币；金属钱币；
v. 创造；
words.ex: He has a coin in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有一枚硬币。
words.en: A coin is a small, flat, round piece of metal or plastic that is used as money.

words.tr:
adj. 音乐的；擅长音乐的；
n. 音乐剧；音乐歌舞片；
words.ex: He loves musical songs.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢音乐的歌曲。
words.en: Relating to music; having the pleasant sound of music.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.ex: We walked along the coast and saw the sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着海岸散步，看到了大海。
words.en: The coast is the land along the edge of the sea or ocean.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.ex: He became mad after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后变得发疯了。
words.en: If you say that someone is mad, you mean that they are very angry.

words.ex: He smokes tobacco every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吸烟草。
words.en: Tobacco is a plant that is grown for its leaves, which are dried and used for smoking in cigarettes, cigars, and pipes, or for chewing or snuffing.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: He lives in France.
words.ex_cn: 他住在法国。
words.en: A country in western Europe, known for its cultural heritage, including art, fashion, and cuisine.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: The keys are within the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: If something is within a place, area, or object, it is inside it or surrounded by it.

words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.ex: He lives in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦。
words.en: London is the capital city of England and the United Kingdom, known for its history, culture, and financial services.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯装满了水。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: I am thankful for my friend's help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激朋友的帮助。
words.en: If you are thankful for something, you are pleased and grateful for it.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: He went to the pub after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了酒吧。
words.en: A pub is a building where people can have drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, and talk to their friends. Many pubs also serve food.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr: n. 含酒精的饮料；酒精；
words.ex: He drank alcohol at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上喝了含酒精的饮料。
words.en: Alcohol is a colourless liquid that can make you drunk, and which is used in medicines, cleaning products, and other substances.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr:
v. 吹；打击；
n. 打击；
words.ex: The wind blows the leaves away.
words.ex_cn: 风吹走了树叶。
words.en: To move air or gas forcefully; to strike something with force.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在三月。
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

words.ex: She gave him a gift for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她送了他一份生日礼物。
words.en: A gift is something that you give someone as a present. It can also refer to a natural ability or talent.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.ex: The birds sing at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.

words.ex: The child screamed when she saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当那个孩子看到狗时，她尖叫了起来。
words.en: If you scream, you shout or cry in a loud high-pitched voice, usually because you are in pain or are very frightened.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.ex: I forgive you for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我原谅你迟到了。
words.en: If you forgive someone who has done something bad or wrong, you stop being angry with them and stop blaming them.

words.tr: v. 生长；成长；渐渐变成；种植；
words.ex: The plant grows quickly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天长得很快。
words.en: If someone or something grows, they increase in size, amount, or degree, often over a period of time.

words.tr:
v. 停止；阻止；
n. 停止；阻止；车站；停留；
words.ex: He stopped walking when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他停止了走路。
words.en: If you stop something from happening, you prevent it from happening or prevent it from continuing.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价50分。
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.ex: There are thirteen apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十三个苹果。
words.en: The number 13, which is one more than twelve and one less than fourteen.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: He studied hard, thus he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.

words.ex: The weather is mild today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气温和。
words.en: Mild is used to describe something that is not extreme, severe, or strong, such as weather, taste, or behavior.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.ex: My birthday is in March.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在三月。
words.en: March is the third month of the Gregorian calendar, following February and preceding April.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a big disaster.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了一场大灾难。
words.en: A disaster is an unexpected event causing great damage, destruction, or distress.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.ex: The farmer planted corn in rich soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民在肥沃的土壤里种了玉米。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow, consisting of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.ex: He is proud of his son's good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子的好成绩感到自豪。
words.en: Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.tr:
adj. 第五的；
n. 五分之一；第五；
adv. 第五；
words.ex: He finished in fifth place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第五名。
words.en: The fifth item in a series is the one that you count as number five.

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr: n. 伤口；创伤； v. “wind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He cleaned the wound with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水清洗了伤口。
words.en: A wound is damage to part of your body, especially a cut or a hole in your flesh, which is caused by a gun, knife, or other weapon.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the lamb every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂羔羊。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.ex: He has a bad lung infection.
words.ex_cn: 他得了严重的肺部感染。
words.en: Your lungs are the two organs inside your chest which fill with air when you breathe in.

words.ex: She wore an elegant dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条优雅的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe a person or thing as elegant, you mean that they are pleasing and graceful in appearance or style.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: He put the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: If you put something in a particular place or position, you move it into that place or position.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: I expect a gift on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我期待在生日时收到一份礼物。
words.en: If you expect something, you believe that it is likely to happen or that it will be the case.

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: The fact is that he was late.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他迟到了。
words.en: A fact is a piece of information that is known to be true.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.ex: My birthday is in February.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在二月。
words.en: February is the second month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.ex: Mommy is making dinner for us.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈正在为我们做晚饭。
words.en: A child's word for mother.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.tr:
conj. 一旦；一…便；
adv. 曾经；一次；
words.ex: Once you finish your homework, you can play.
words.ex_cn: 一旦你完成作业，就可以玩了。
words.en: At one time in the past; formerly.

words.ex: She took a glance at the clock.
words.ex_cn: 她瞥了一眼钟。
words.en: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.ex: The dialogue in the movie was very funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影中的对白非常幽默。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.ex: His humor makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让大家都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.ex: The cat used its claw to scratch the tree.
words.ex_cn: 猫用爪子抓树。
words.en: A claw is a curved pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds, lizards, and some mammals. As a verb, it means to scratch, tear, or pull with claws or fingernails.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.tr:
n. 长队；
v. 排队；
words.ex: There is a long queue at the ticket counter.
words.ex_cn: 售票处排着一条长队。
words.en: A queue is a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: He faced difficulty in solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决这道数学题时遇到了困难。
words.en: A difficulty is a problem or issue that is hard to deal with or understand.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: She blesses her children every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上为孩子们祝福。
words.en: If someone is blessed with a particular good quality or skill, they have that good quality or skill.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: He is tired, and indeed he fell asleep quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，的确很快就睡着了。
words.en: You use indeed to confirm or agree with something that has just been said.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.tr: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的；
words.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张单程公交车票。
words.en: Only one in number; one only; not married or not involved in a stable romantic relationship.

words.ex: The temperature remains high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天温度保持很高。
words.en: If someone or something remains in a particular state or condition, they stay in that state or condition and do not change.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.ex: He arrives at the station at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他早上8点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a place, especially at the end of a journey.

words.tr: adj. 上瘾了的；入了迷的
words.ex: He is addicted to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: If you are addicted to something, you cannot stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to you.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.tr: n. 马拉松赛跑；耐力赛；
words.ex: He ran a marathon last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期日跑了一场马拉松赛跑。
words.en: A marathon is a long-distance running event with an official distance of 42.195 kilometers (26 miles 385 yards), usually run as a road race. The event was instituted in commemoration of the fabled run of the Greek soldier Pheidippides, a messenger from the Battle of Marathon to Athens.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天步行去学校。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: She put jam on her bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐在面包上涂了果酱。
words.en: Jam is a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar until it is thick. It is usually spread on bread or toast. Jam can also refer to a situation where things are crowded or blocked, or the act of forcing something into a tight space.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: My birthday is in December.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在十二月。
words.en: December is the twelfth and last month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars and the seventh and last of seven months to have a length of 31 days.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都说你好。
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: He ate a biscuit with tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.ex: You can leave your bag wherever you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以把包放在任何你喜欢的地方。
words.en: in or to any place; in any case or situation

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃汤。
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: The exit is near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: I pick the red shirt for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我为派对选择红色衬衫。
words.en: To choose something from a group of things or people, or to remove something from a place using your fingers or a tool.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: He lost a lot of blood after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。
words.en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: My neighbor gives me apples from her tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从她的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbor is someone who lives near you, or a country that is next to another country.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: The cow eats straw from the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛吃谷仓里的稻草。
words.en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic that you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

words.ex: He suffered from a bad cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周患了重感冒。
words.en: To experience something unpleasant, such as injury, pain, or loss.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: He will retire next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将退休。
words.en: If you retire, you stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age or because you are ill.

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.ex_cn: 大厅里有一百名学生。
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.tr:
v. 支付；付出代价；
n. 工资；
words.ex: He will pay for the food tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会支付饭钱。
words.en: If you pay for something which you buy or for a service which you use, you give money to the person who is selling it or providing it.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.tr:
adv. 非常地；
adj. 多；许多；
pron. 许多；
words.ex: She is much happier now.
words.ex_cn: 她现在快乐多了。
words.en: A large amount or to a great degree.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.ex: She was born in Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在英国。
words.en: Britain is a country in Europe consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, known for its history, culture, and influence in the world.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 很少有人来参加会议。
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.tr:
conj. 也不；也没有；
adv. 也不；也没有；
words.ex: He doesn't like coffee, nor does she.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢咖啡，她也不喜欢。
words.en: used before the second or last of a set of negative possibilities, usually after 'neither'

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他挥挥手打招呼。
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: The frog jumps over the pond.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跳过池塘。
words.en: A frog is a small creature with smooth skin, big eyes, and long back legs, which it uses for jumping. Frogs live in or near water.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: The loud noise frightened the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something or someone frightens you, they cause you to suddenly feel afraid, anxious, or nervous.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: He wore a strange hat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去学校。
words.en: If something is strange, it is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: He drinks wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时喝葡萄酒。
words.en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: I consider going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我考虑明天去公园。
words.en: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.ex: We eat lunch at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Noon is the middle of the day, 12 o'clock in the daytime.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.ex: The movie is controversial because it shows violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影因为展示暴力而有争议。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as controversial, you mean that they are the subject of intense public argument, disagreement, or disapproval.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
n. 梳子
v. 梳理；搜寻
words.ex: He uses a comb to tidy his hair.
words.ex_cn: 他用梳子整理头发。
words.en: A comb is a flat piece of plastic or metal with narrow pointed teeth along one side, which you use to make your hair neat.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: The two teams decide to unite for the competition.
words.ex_cn: 这两个队伍决定在比赛中联合起来。
words.en: If a group of people or things unite or if someone unites them, they join together and act as a group.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.ex: He hunts deer in the forest every autumn.
words.ex_cn: 他每年秋天在森林里打猎。
words.en: To hunt means to chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport.

words.ex: He was frank about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If someone is frank, they state or express things in an open and honest way.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: He lifted a ton of bricks yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天搬了一吨砖。
words.en: A ton is a unit of weight equal to 2,240 pounds in Britain and 2,000 pounds in the United States. It is also used informally to mean a large amount of something.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.tr: n. 全体船员；全体人员；
words.ex: The crew fixed the ship's engine during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 全体船员在风暴中修好了船的引擎。
words.en: A crew is a group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, or train.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.ex: He eats a strawberry every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗草莓。
words.en: A strawberry is a small red fruit which is soft and juicy and has tiny yellow seeds on its surface.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.tr:
n. 水果；
v. 结果实；
words.ex: I like fruit.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果。
words.en: The edible part of a plant that develops from a flower, especially one that is sweet and contains seeds.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；持有；容纳；保留；举行；
n. 拿；控制；持；
words.ex: He held the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; to maintain in a grasp; to keep in a specified state, relation, or position; to contain or be capable of containing; to have in one's possession; to keep back from action; to delay the action or effect of; to keep in custody; to bear, sustain, or support; to have or maintain in the mind; to consider or esteem; to assert or affirm; to organize and carry on; to have the ownership or use of; to keep from falling or moving; to remain unbroken or unyielding; to remain attached or faithful; to remain valid or effective.

words.tr:
v. 呜咽；抽噎
n. 抽噎（声）；啜泣（声）
words.ex: The little girl sobbed after losing her toy.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在丢失玩具后哭了起来。
words.en: To cry noisily, taking in short breaths.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.tr:
adj. 英国的；不列颠的；英国人的；
n. （统称）英国人；
words.ex: He loves British tea and biscuits.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢英国的茶和饼干。
words.en: relating to Great Britain or the United Kingdom, or its people or language

words.tr:
n. 烤架；铁格子
v. 烧烤；拷问
words.ex: He cooked the burgers on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他用烤架烤了汉堡。
words.en: To cook food on a metal frame over a fire, or a metal frame used for cooking food in this way.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.tr:
adv. 在户外；在野外；
n. 野外；旷野；郊外；
words.ex: The children love to play outdoors.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。
words.en: If something happens outdoors, it happens outside in the fresh air rather than in a building.

words.ex: He put the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.ex: The train runs on the rail.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A rail is a horizontal bar, typically made of metal or wood, used as a support or barrier; or a track made of steel rails along which trains run.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.ex: He inferred that she was tired from her yawns.
words.ex_cn: 他从她的哈欠推断出她很累。
words.en: If you infer that something is the case, you decide that it is true on the basis of information that you already have.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个瓶子里喝水。
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: The North Pole is covered with ice all year round.
words.ex_cn: 北极全年都被冰雪覆盖。
words.en: A pole is a long, thin, rounded piece of wood or metal, used especially for supporting things.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr:
n. 疼痛；隐痛；渴望
v. 疼痛；隐痛
words.ex: My head aches after staying up late.
words.ex_cn: 我熬夜后头痛。
words.en: If you ache or a part of your body aches, you feel a steady, fairly strong pain.

words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天讲英语。
words.en: To say words in order to express thoughts, feelings, or opinions.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
