words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.tr: n. 山；山脉；一大堆；大量；
words.ex: He climbed a tall mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他爬了一座高山。
words.en: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides, much higher than a hill.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.tr:
adj. 这样的；如此的；
pron. 这样的人或事；
words.ex: He made such a big mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他犯了这样的大错。
words.en: You use such to refer back to the thing or person that you have just mentioned, or a thing or person like the one that you have just mentioned. You use such as and such...as to introduce examples of the thing or person that you have just mentioned.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: The taxpayer paid his taxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 纳税人按时缴税了。
words.en: A taxpayer is a person or organization that pays taxes to the government.

words.ex: He often criticizes his brother for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他经常批评他弟弟迟到。
words.en: If you criticize someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.ex: The lorry carried boxes to the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了仓库。
words.en: A lorry is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.ex: The snake crawled slowly through the grass.
words.ex_cn: 蛇在草丛中缓慢地爬行。
words.en: A snake is a long, thin creature with no legs that slides along the ground.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样快。
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

words.ex: The thief stole a wallet from the bag.
words.ex_cn: 小偷偷走了包里的钱包。
words.en: A thief is a person who steals something from another person or place.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.tr:
n. 平原；
adj. 简单明了的；朴素的；
words.ex: The cows graze on the plain.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: If something is plain, it is easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.tr:
n. 照料；谨慎；关心；
v. 关心；在意；在乎；
words.ex: The nurse gave the baby good care.
words.ex_cn: 护士给了婴儿很好的照料。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: They signed an agreement to share the costs.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份分担费用的协议。
words.en: An agreement is a formal decision about future action which is made by two or more people, groups, or organizations.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.ex: He listens to music to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.

words.ex: He disappointed his parents by failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他考试不及格，让父母失望了。
words.en: If things or people disappoint you, they are not as good as you had hoped, or do not do what you expected them to do.

words.tr: v. 遭受；忍受；“suffer”的现在分词； n. 痛苦；苦难；折磨；
words.ex: He is suffering from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他正遭受一场重感冒。
words.en: Suffering is the experience of mental or physical pain.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他去国外学医。
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.ex: He plays chess every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上下棋。
words.en: Chess is a board game for two players, each beginning with 16 pieces of six kinds that are moved according to specific rules, the object being to checkmate the opponent's king.

words.tr: v. 效劳；服务；为……工作；招待；
words.ex: He serves the community as a volunteer.
words.ex_cn: 他作为志愿者为社区效劳。
words.en: To perform duties or services for (a person or an organization).

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.tr:
adj. 自己的；
v. 拥有；
words.ex: This is my own book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: If you own something, it belongs to you.

words.ex: He wakes up at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点醒来。
words.en: To wake means to stop sleeping or to cause someone to stop sleeping. It can also refer to the trail left by a moving ship.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: The bomb will explode at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹将在中午爆炸。
words.en: If an object explodes, it bursts loudly and with great force, often causing damage or injury.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.ex: He put the food on a clean dish.
words.ex_cn: 他把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A dish is a shallow container used for cooking or serving food.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.tr:
n. 收获；收成；
v. 收获；收割；
words.ex: The farmers celebrated the harvest in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天庆祝收获。
words.en: The harvest is the process of gathering mature crops from the fields. It is a crucial activity in agriculture that marks the end of the growing season.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.ex: She bought new decoration for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了新的装饰品。
words.en: Decoration is the process or art of decorating something, or the objects used to decorate something.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了工作。
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.ex: The soup is hot.
words.ex_cn: 汤是热的。
words.en: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He finished in seventh place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第七名。
words.en: The seventh item in a series is the one that you count as number seven.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.tr:
n. 山；
v. 逐渐增加；
words.ex: He climbed the mount early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他一大早爬了那座山。
words.en: To mount something means to go up it or to get on it. It can also refer to the act of organizing and beginning something, such as an event or an exhibition.

words.tr: v. “be”的现在分词；是；在； n. 存在；生物；人；生命；
words.ex: He is being quiet in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆里保持安静。
words.en: The state or quality of having existence.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.ex: She wore a dress for the occasion.
words.ex_cn: 她为了这个特殊场合穿了一条裙子。
words.en: An occasion is a particular time when something happens, or a special event.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: I prepare my lunch every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上准备午餐。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: The train runs on the railway.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.ex: The old tree died last winter.
words.ex_cn: 那棵老树去年冬天死了。
words.en: To die means to stop living and become dead.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.ex: The farmer drives a tractor in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里开拖拉机。
words.en: A tractor is a powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment and trailers.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: He will arrive soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会到。
words.en: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.ex_cn: 她打开灯来读书。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天学习英语。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: He will repeat the question.
words.ex_cn: 他会重复这个问题。
words.en: To say or write something again, either once or several times.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: He learned about slavery in history class.
words.ex_cn: 他在历史课上学到了奴隶制。
words.en: Slavery is the system by which people are owned by other people as slaves.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: He practises piano every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习钢琴。
words.en: To do something repeatedly in order to improve your skill at it.

words.ex: He ate a slice of apple pie for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块苹果派作为甜点。
words.en: A pie is a baked dish which is usually made of a pastry dough casing that contains a filling of various sweet or savoury ingredients.

words.ex: The president signed the new contract.
words.ex_cn: 总裁签署了新合同。
words.en: The president is the elected head of a republic or the head of a company or organization.

words.ex: He likes chemistry because it is fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢化学，因为它很有趣。
words.en: Chemistry is the scientific study of the structure of substances and how they react with each other.

words.tr:
v. 希望；
n. 希望；
words.ex: I hope it rains tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望明天下雨。
words.en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.tr: v. 找到；发现；感到；认为；
words.ex: I found my keys under the table.
words.ex_cn: 我在桌子下面找到了我的钥匙。
words.en: If you find someone or something, you see them or learn where they are, either by chance or because you have been looking for them.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.tr: adj. 急剧的；引人注目的；戏剧（性）的；
words.ex: There was a dramatic increase in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度急剧上升。
words.en: If something is dramatic, it happens or changes suddenly and noticeably.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期二有一个会议。
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.ex: The company made a statement about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 公司就新政策发布了一项声明。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: We have sufficient food for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们有足够的食物用于这次旅行。
words.en: If something is sufficient for a particular purpose, there is enough of it for the purpose.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了外衣。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.tr:
auxv. 必须；一定要；
n. 必须做的事；必不可少的事物；
words.ex: You must finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is very likely or certain to be true or to happen.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度迅速下降。
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.tr:
v. 滚动；
n. 滚动；卷形物；
words.ex: The ball roll down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球从山上滚下来。
words.en: To move somewhere by turning over and over, or to make something move in this way.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.ex_cn: 风从北方吹来。
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.tr: v. “say”的现在分词；说； n. 谚语；警句；
words.ex: He is saying goodbye to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友们道别。
words.en: A short, well-known expression that states a general truth or gives advice.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.tr: adj. 流传甚广的；分布广的；
words.ex: The flu became widespread last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天流感流传甚广。
words.en: Something that is widespread exists or happens over a large area, or to a great extent.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: The doctor treated his disease with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生用药物治疗了他的疾病。
words.en: A disease is an illness that affects people, animals, or plants, often caused by infection or a failure of health rather than by an accident.

words.tr: adj. 壮观的；辉煌的；极好的；
words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was splendid.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落非常壮观。
words.en: If you say that something is splendid, you mean that it is very good.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树周围跑。
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 我能够游得很好。
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.ex: I had coffee at a small caf near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近的一家小咖啡馆喝了咖啡。
words.en: A small restaurant or coffee shop that serves light meals and drinks.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: The teacher will punish the student for cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师会因为作弊而惩罚那个学生。
words.en: To punish someone means to make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: The aircraft landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这架航空器在机场安全着陆。
words.en: An aircraft is a vehicle which can fly, for example an aeroplane or a helicopter.

words.tr:
v. 喂；吃；
n. 饲养；喂养；
words.ex: She feeds the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喂猫。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr:
adv. 向后地；
adj. 向后的；
words.ex: He walked backward to see the sign.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走以便看清楚那个标志。
words.en: If you move or look backward, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.ex: The farmer walks his ox to the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫牵着他的牛去田里。
words.en: An ox is a large animal with four legs, which is often used for pulling farm equipment or carrying heavy loads.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.ex: He lives in Russia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄罗斯。
words.en: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, known for its vast territory and rich history.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.tr:
adv. 两者都不；
adj. 两者都不的；
conj. 也不；
pron. 两者都不；
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and neither do I like tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a further negative statement after a negative one, or to indicate that a negative statement is also true of another person or thing

words.ex: He walked up the stair to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯到了二楼。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: He sat on the bench in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在公园的长凳上。
words.en: A bench is a long seat for several people, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.tr:
adj. 道德的；道义上的；
n. 寓意；
words.ex: It is a moral duty to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 说实话是一种道德责任。
words.en: Concerned with the principles of right and wrong behavior and the goodness or badness of human character.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: The child loves to play with fantasy stories about dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢玩关于龙的幻想故事。
words.en: A fantasy is a pleasant situation or event that you imagine, which is unlikely to happen.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.tr:
n. 物体；
v. 反对；
words.ex: The ball is a simple object.
words.ex_cn: 球是一个简单的物体。
words.en: An object is a thing that you can see or touch but that is not usually a living animal, plant, or person.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.ex: The baby is asleep in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡着了。
words.en: If someone is asleep, they are sleeping.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.ex: She showed great affection for her little dog.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的小狗非常钟爱。
words.en: A feeling of liking and caring for someone or something.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: He wore a rag to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块破布擦地板。
words.en: A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things. As a verb, to rag means to tease or mock someone persistently.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: You must clean the room properly.
words.ex_cn: 你必须正确地打扫房间。
words.en: If something is done properly, it is done in a correct and satisfactory way.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.tr:
n. 农场；农庄；
v. 耕种；
words.ex: He works on a small farm with cows and chickens.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个养牛和鸡的小农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, together with the buildings on it, that is used for growing crops or raising animals.

words.ex: The school forbids students to use phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: To forbid something means to order that it must not be done.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

words.ex: There are eleven apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十一个苹果。
words.en: The number 11.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: He sent her a card with congratulations.
words.ex_cn: 他给她寄了一张写有祝贺的卡片。
words.en: an expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.ex: A sparrow flew over the garden.
words.ex_cn: 一只麻雀飞过了花园。
words.en: A sparrow is a small brown bird that is very common in many parts of the world.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.ex: India is a country in South Asia.
words.ex_cn: 印度是南亚的一个国家。
words.en: A country in South Asia, known for its diverse culture, history, and religions.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙存在于数百万年前。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: The hunter caught a deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 猎人在森林里捕到了一只鹿。
words.en: A hunter is a person who hunts wild animals for food or as a sport.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.tr:
adj. 第三的；
n. 三分之一；第三；
adv. 第三；
words.ex: He finished in third place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第三名。
words.en: Coming after the second and just before the fourth in position.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.tr:
n. 问题；疑问；
v. 怀疑；询问；
words.ex: He asked a simple question in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上问了一个简单的问题。
words.en: A sentence or phrase used to find out information.

words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.ex: He squeezed into the small seat.
words.ex_cn: 他挤进了小座位里。
words.en: To squeeze something means to press it firmly, usually with your fingers or hands, often to get liquid out of it or to make it smaller.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: The cat jumped onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
words.en: If something moves or is put onto an object or surface, it is then on that object or surface.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: He embarrassed himself in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班同学面前让自己丢脸了。
words.en: If you embarrass someone, you make them feel shy, ashamed, or guilty about something.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.tr:
adj. 高尚的；
n. 贵族；
words.ex: He made a noble decision to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了一个高尚的决定去帮助穷人。
words.en: If you say that someone is a noble person, you admire and respect them because they are unselfish and morally good.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这是个好主意。
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: Don't bother to clean the room, I'll do it later.
words.ex_cn: 别麻烦去打扫房间了，我稍后会做。
words.en: To bother someone means to cause them trouble or to annoy them.

words.ex: He is deaf and uses sign language to communicate.
words.ex_cn: 他是聋的，使用手语交流。
words.en: If someone is deaf, they cannot hear anything, or they cannot hear very well.

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 或许明天会下雨。
words.en: You use perhaps to express uncertainty, for example, when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他以喝咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.ex: The volcano erupts suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火山突然喷发。
words.en: If a volcano erupts, it throws out smoke, fire, and melted rocks.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: There was a sudden noise in the night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里突然传来一阵响声。
words.en: If something is sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr:
n. 打印；印刷；
v. 打印；印刷；
words.ex: The print of the photo is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片的打印很清晰。
words.en: To produce text or pictures on paper, usually using a machine called a printer.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.tr: adj. 难以忍受的；不能容忍的
words.ex: The heat was unbearable.
words.ex_cn: 天气热得难以忍受。
words.en: If you describe something as unbearable, you mean that it is so unpleasant, painful, or upsetting that you feel unable to accept it or deal with it.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.ex: She gave him a sweet kiss goodnight.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他一个甜蜜的晚安之吻。
words.en: To touch or press your lips against someone or something as a sign of love or affection.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: He shouted for help when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时大叫着求救。
words.en: If you shout, you say something very loudly, usually because you want people a long distance away to hear you or because you are angry.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr: adv. 曾经；在任何时候；总是；
words.ex: Have you ever been to Paris?
words.ex_cn: 你曾经去过巴黎吗？
words.en: At any time; always; in any case; used for emphasis when you are comparing things.

words.ex: He made a stupid mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is stupid, you mean that they show a lack of good judgment or intelligence and they are not at all sensible.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.ex: Please shut the door.
words.ex_cn: 请关上门。
words.en: To shut something means to move it so that it fills an opening or to move it so that it is no longer open.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.ex: This is a good instance of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An instance is a particular example or case of something.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.tr:
n. 指挥；命令；
v. 掌握；
words.ex: The general has command of the army.
words.ex_cn: 将军指挥着军队。
words.en: If someone in authority commands you to do something, they tell you that you must do it.

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into or expelled from the lungs.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.
